source: RoyaleSim cards-160635007-20261103.json (cards-160635007-20261103.1): 160635007 client, content 16.635.8 (the 2026-11-03 update); card list, ids, elixir and rarity from data/cards_api.json
notes: record / units / area_effects: the game's level-1 values, in its own units (see conventions).

levels: every HP/damage amount at that level, flattened as dotted paths into record, e.g. projectile.damage, units.Barbarian.hitpoints, area_effects.GoblinDrillDamageArea.damage. Derived: dps = damage / hit speed, crown_tower_damage, total_* (all waves), damage_per_hit / damage_per_second (damage over time).
Levels 11-16 only: 16 is the highest playable level; levels below 11 are left out on purpose.
Checked against statsroyale.com for 12 cards in tests/test_card_levels.py.

conventions.distance_units: millitiles (1 tile = 1000); engine converts via fixed::milli()
conventions.speed_units: raw Speed column; conversion is calibration.json time.SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK
conventions.booleans: a blank boolean cell is false (Supercell loader default); a boolean column the table lacks entirely is null
conventions.nulls: null means the source row has no value and no safe default exists; a default that WAS applied is listed in each record's defaults_applied
conventions.crown_tower_damage_percent: effective percent; HYPOTHESIS that a negative raw value is a delta from 100 (raw kept alongside where it exists)
conventions.level_scaling: multiplier_percent_by_level[L-1] is the percent of the level-1 stat at level L -- L counted from level_scaling.base_level (unified; 1 on every base card: the OBJECT's Rarity row is Common), the card's rarity / level_count / relative_level bound the playable levels; level_scaling.reading names the ledger candidate (combat.STAT_BASE_LEVEL) the block was built under

conditions: has_data(ElixirGolem1) || has_data(InfernoDragon) || has_data(MergeMaiden_Mounted) || has_data(MightyMiner) || has_data(MovingCannon) || has_data(SuperHogRider_Terry) || has_data(SuperIceGolemite)|| has_data(BombTower) || has_data(InfernoTower)
